sqliteMaster.name: idx_words_is_custom_status
sqliteMaster.sql: CREATE INDEX idx_words_is_custom_status ON words (is_custom, status)

sqliteMaster.name: app_settings
sqliteMaster.sql:
CREATE TABLE app_settings (
    key TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    value TEXT NOT NULL
  )

sqliteMaster.name: daily_progress
sqliteMaster.sql:
CREATE TABLE daily_progress (
    local_day TEXT PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL,
    introduced INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (introduced >= 0)
  )

sqliteMaster.name: word_topics
sqliteMaster.sql:
CREATE TABLE word_topics (
    topic TEXT NOT NULL,
    dict_key TEXT NOT NULL,
    PRIMARY KEY (topic, dict_key)
  ) WITHOUT ROWID

sqliteMaster.name: words
sqliteMaster.sql:
CREATE TABLE words (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
    dict_key TEXT UNIQUE,
    term TEXT NOT NULL,
    translation TEXT NOT NULL,
    transcription TEXT,
    example TEXT,
    is_custom INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (is_custom IN (0, 1)),
    status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new'
      CHECK (status IN ('new', 'review', 'learned')),
    rank INTEGER,
    CHECK ((is_custom = 1) = (dict_key IS NULL))
  )
